```{r}
data_dir <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/Data/"

Data.input = readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "Seurat_RNA_ATAC_CD8_NK.rds"))
```

# Run MOFA

```{r}
PID.use = c(9, 12)
output.list = list()

for (i in 1:length(PID.use)) {
  seurat = subset(Data.input, subset = PID == PID.use[i])
  
  N = nrow(seurat@assays$RNA@data) # used all the measured genes
  
  seurat <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat, 
                                 selection.method = "vst", 
                                 nfeatures = N,
                                 assay = "RNA",
                                 verbose = FALSE
  )
  
  seurat <- FindTopFeatures(seurat, assay="ATAC", min.cutoff = 0)
  
  
  seurat <- UpdateSeuratObject(seurat)
  
  # train the model
  mofa <- create_mofa(seurat, assays = c("RNA","ATAC"))
  
  # use 15 factors
  model_opts <- get_default_model_options(mofa)
  model_opts$num_factors <- 15
  
  mofa <- prepare_mofa(mofa,
                       model_options = model_opts
  )
  
  # run the analysis
  mofa <- run_mofa(mofa, use_basilisk = TRUE)
  
  output.list[[i]] = mofa
}
```


```{r}
saveRDS( output.list, file = "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/MOFA/MOFA_output_allgenes_NK_CD8_PID_9_12.rds")
```

# MOFA output analysis

```{r}
data_dir <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/Data/"
Data.input = readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "Seurat_RNA_ATAC_CD8_NK.rds"))
```



```{r}
PID.use = c(9, 12)

output.list = MOFA_output_allgenes_NK_CD8_PID_9_12

i = 1

mofa = output.list[[i]]
seurat = subset(Data.input, subset = PID == PID.use[i])
```


```{r}
# 1. Get factor scores (shared across views/modalities — this is the whole point of MOFA)
Z <- get_factors(mofa, as.data.frame = TRUE)      # sample, factor, value

# 2. Get weights for BOTH views
W_rna <- get_weights(mofa, views = "RNA", as.data.frame = TRUE)
W_atac <- get_weights(mofa, views = "ATAC", as.data.frame = TRUE)  # adjust view name to match yours

# 3. Attach cell type labels to factor scores
Z <- Z %>%
  left_join(data.frame(sample = rownames(seurat@meta.data), cell_type = seurat@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l1), by = "sample")

# 4. Mean factor activity per group
factor_activity <- Z %>%
  group_by(cell_type, factor) %>%
  summarize(mean_score = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

nk_activity  <- factor_activity %>% dplyr::filter(cell_type == "NK")
cd8_activity <- factor_activity %>% dplyr::filter(cell_type == "CD8 T")

# 5. Per-gene score from EACH view separately, then combine
score_from_view <- function(W, activity_df) {
  W %>%
    left_join(activity_df, by = "factor") %>%
    group_by(feature) %>%
    summarize(score = sum(value * mean_score), .groups = "drop")
}

rna_nk   <- score_from_view(W_rna,  nk_activity)  %>% rename(rna_score = score)
atac_nk  <- score_from_view(W_atac, nk_activity)  %>% rename(atac_score = score)
rna_cd8  <- score_from_view(W_rna,  cd8_activity) %>% rename(rna_score = score)
atac_cd8 <- score_from_view(W_atac, cd8_activity) %>% rename(atac_score = score)

# 6. Combine RNA + ATAC scores per gene, per group
#    NOTE: this requires ATAC features to be mapped to gene names (e.g. gene activity scores,
#    not raw peak coordinates) so 'feature' matches between W_rna and W_atac
nk_combined <- rna_nk %>%
  full_join(atac_nk, by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(across(c(rna_score, atac_score), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(combined_score = rna_score + atac_score) %>%
  mutate(
    gene = sub("_(RNA|ATAC)$", "", feature)
  )

cd8_combined <- rna_cd8 %>%
  full_join(atac_cd8, by = "feature") %>%
  mutate(across(c(rna_score, atac_score), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
  mutate(combined_score = rna_score + atac_score) %>%
  mutate(
    gene = sub("_(RNA|ATAC)$", "", feature)
  )

```




```{r}
N = 10000

# 7. Rank
top_nk_mofa  <- nk_combined  %>% 
  arrange(desc(combined_score)) %>% 
  pull(gene) %>% 
  head(N)

top_cd8_mofa <- cd8_combined %>% 
  arrange(desc(combined_score)) %>% 
  pull(gene) %>% 
  head(N)

intersect(NK_panel, top_nk_mofa )

intersect(NK_signal, top_nk_mofa )
intersect(CD8_signal, top_cd8_mofa )

intersect(c("SYNCRIP", "RARA", "NFATC3", "NR3C1", "FOS", "YBX1", "DDX5", "NPM1", "MARK14"), top_cd8_mofa)
intersect(c("IFIT3", "MX1", "BRD4", "IFITM1", "MX2", "AIM2", "SLFN11"), top_cd8_mofa)
```

################################################################################


```{r}
data_dir <- "~/Research_2025/Gladstone/Data/"
Data.input = readRDS(paste0(data_dir, "Seurat_RNA_ATAC_CD8_NK.rds"))
output.list = MOFA_output_allgenes_NK_CD8_PID_9_12


PID = c(9, 12)
df.list = list()

for (i in 1:2) {
  mofa = output.list[[i]]
  seurat = subset(Data.input, subset = PID == PID.use[i])
  
  # 1. Get factor scores (shared across views/modalities — this is the whole point of MOFA)
  Z <- get_factors(mofa, as.data.frame = TRUE)      # sample, factor, value
  
  # 2. Get weights for BOTH views
  W_rna <- get_weights(mofa, views = "RNA", as.data.frame = TRUE)
  W_atac <- get_weights(mofa, views = "ATAC", as.data.frame = TRUE)  # adjust view name to match yours
  
  # 3. Attach cell type labels to factor scores
  Z <- Z %>%
    left_join(data.frame(sample = rownames(seurat@meta.data), cell_type = seurat@meta.data$predicted.celltype.l1), by = "sample")
  
  # 4. Mean factor activity per group
  factor_activity <- Z %>%
    group_by(cell_type, factor) %>%
    summarize(mean_score = mean(value), .groups = "drop")
  
  nk_activity  <- factor_activity %>% dplyr::filter(cell_type == "NK")
  cd8_activity <- factor_activity %>% dplyr::filter(cell_type == "CD8 T")
  
  # 5. Per-gene score from EACH view separately, then combine
  score_from_view <- function(W, activity_df) {
    W %>%
      left_join(activity_df, by = "factor") %>%
      group_by(feature) %>%
      summarize(score = sum(value * mean_score), .groups = "drop")
  }
  
  rna_nk   <- score_from_view(W_rna,  nk_activity)  %>% 
    rename(rna_score = score) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = sub("_(RNA|ATAC)$", "", feature)
    )
  
  atac_nk  <- score_from_view(W_atac, nk_activity)  %>% 
    rename(atac_score = score) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = sub("_(RNA|ATAC)$", "", feature)
    )
  
  rna_cd8  <- score_from_view(W_rna,  cd8_activity) %>% 
    rename(rna_score = score) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = sub("_(RNA|ATAC)$", "", feature)
    )
  
  atac_cd8 <- score_from_view(W_atac, cd8_activity) %>% 
    rename(atac_score = score) %>%
    mutate(
      gene = sub("_(RNA|ATAC)$", "", feature)
    )
  
  
  nk_combined <- rna_nk %>%
    full_join(atac_nk, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(across(c(rna_score, atac_score), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    mutate(combined_score = 0.5*(rna_score + atac_score) )
  
  
  cd8_combined <- rna_cd8 %>%
    full_join(atac_cd8, by = "gene") %>%
    mutate(across(c(rna_score, atac_score), ~replace_na(., 0))) %>%
    mutate(combined_score = 0.5*(rna_score + atac_score) )
  
  # Merged table for NK and CD8 T
  
  df_NK <- rna_nk %>%
    full_join(atac_nk, by = "gene")  %>%
    full_join(nk_combined[ , c("gene", "combined_score")], by = "gene")
  
  df_CD8 <- rna_cd8 %>%
    full_join(atac_cd8, by = "gene")  %>%
    full_join(cd8_combined[ , c("gene", "combined_score")], by = "gene")
  
  # function for obtain the rank
  
  rank_by <- function(df, score_col, gene_col = "gene") {
    ranked <- df[order(-df[[score_col]]), ]
    ranked$rank <- seq_len(nrow(ranked))
    setNames(ranked$rank, ranked[[gene_col]])[genes_of_interest]
  }
  
  # get the rank for NK signals
  
  genes_of_interest <- c(NK_panel, NK_signal)
  df = df_NK
  
  comparison <- data.frame(
    gene           = genes_of_interest,
    rank_rna       = rank_by(df, "rna_score"),
    rank_atac      = rank_by(df, "atac_score"),
    rank_combined  = rank_by(df, "combined_score")
  )
  
  comparison_nk <- comparison[order(comparison$rank_combined), ]
  comparison_nk$cell_type = "NK"
  comparison_nk$PID = PID[i]
  
  # get the rank for CD8 signals
  
  genes_of_interest <- CD8_signal
  df = df_CD8
  
  comparison <- data.frame(
    gene           = genes_of_interest,
    rank_rna       = rank_by(df, "rna_score"),
    rank_atac      = rank_by(df, "atac_score"),
    rank_combined  = rank_by(df, "combined_score")
  )
  
  comparison_cd8 <- comparison[order(comparison$rank_combined), ]
  comparison_cd8$cell_type = "CD8_T"
  comparison_cd8$PID = PID[i]
  
  df.list[[i]] = rbind(comparison_nk, comparison_cd8)
}
```


```{r}
MOFA_3score_comparison = rbindlist(df.list)

write.csv(MOFA_3score_comparison, file = "~/Research_2026/STTT_letter/STTT_Letter_Revision/MOFA_3score_comparison.csv")
```
